description: 광주교통공사_역사별 안내음성 데이터 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 광주교통공사. 광주교통공사 도시철도 역사별 음성 안내 서비스를 체계적으로 관리하기 위해 구축된 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 광주교통공사. Its tags are 교통, 철도, 지하철, 음성, 서비스. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
